title: Nightly dependency-update run
mainFlow: merge the PRs whose checks pass
file one summary issue listing merged and skipped PRs
extensions: if CI is red on main before the run starts → skip the run and note it in the summary issue
if a rebase conflicts → leave the PR untouched and list it as skipped
if a merged PR's checks fail after merge → revert the merge and reopen the PR
done: one summary issue filed, listing every PR as merged, skipped, or failed
